raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Square domain side length",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Results specifies a square with four equal cells per side but gives no physical side length or units. Below, coordinates use Ω=[0,L]×[0,L], with y upward.",
      "readings": [
        "L=1 in nondimensional units",
        "L=100 mm",
        "L=1 m"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither the compliance setup nor FEM Methods specifies thickness or a unit-depth convention. With the elastic reduction and total force fixed, uniform thickness affects dimensional compliance and cancels from the normalized objective.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit out-of-plane depth",
        "Uniform thickness t=L/100",
        "Uniform thickness t=L/10"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Bottom-left roller",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Results says 'bottom left edge' without identifying the constrained nodes or segment endpoints. The prohibited vertical displacement is explicit; its spatial extent is not.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain vertical displacement only at (0,0)",
        "Constrain vertical displacement along y=0, 0≤x≤L/4",
        "Constrain vertical displacement along y=0, 0≤x≤L/2",
        "Constrain vertical displacement along x=0, 0≤y≤L/4"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Downward load near the top-right corner",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Results locates the force at the 'top right edge' but supplies neither coordinates nor an unambiguous choice between the top and right edges.",
      "readings": [
        "Load at the corner (L,L)",
        "Load on the top edge at (3L/4,L)",
        "Load on the right edge at (L,3L/4)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Downward boundary load",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The compliance setup does not specify whether 'a force' is concentrated or distributed, or give a loaded length or traction profile.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated force at one boundary node",
        "Uniform downward traction over one boundary mesh edge of length L/4",
        "Uniform downward traction over a boundary segment of length L/2",
        "Linearly varying downward traction over one boundary mesh edge of length L/4"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Resultant downward force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Results gives the direction but no force magnitude or traction intensity. A common load multiplier cancels from Eq. (4) in linear elasticity.",
      "readings": [
        "Total downward force P=1 N",
        "Total downward force P=100 N",
        "Total downward force P=1000 N"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Protected material at load and support attachments",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The setup gives no explicit passive-region mask or statement about protected attachment material at the force and roller.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive regions; all 25 nodal densities remain designable",
        "Fix the load and roller attachment nodes to density 1",
        "Reserve one-cell solid attachment pads at the load and roller"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus Y0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (6) introduces Y0 without a numerical value. Holding ε/Y0 fixed, its common stiffness scale changes dimensional energy but cancels from Eq. (4).",
      "readings": [
        "Y0=1 in consistent nondimensional units",
        "Y0=1 GPa",
        "Y0=200 GPa"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The compliance formulation specifies Young's modulus interpolation but never supplies Poisson's ratio.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform Poisson's ratio ν=0",
        "Uniform Poisson's ratio ν=0.25",
        "Uniform Poisson's ratio ν=0.30"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elastic constitutive model",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The square-domain formulation and FEM Methods do not identify a plane-stress or plane-strain model.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Residual stiffness ε relative to Y0",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (6) calls ε 'a small number' but gives no value or stiffness contrast.",
      "readings": [
        "ε/Y0=10^-3",
        "ε/Y0=10^-6",
        "ε/Y0=10^-9"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Additional compliance filtering",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No additional density or sensitivity filter is specified for Fig. 2. The stated Helmholtz filter belongs to the heat problem's Approximated baseline and does not determine compliance filtering.",
      "readings": [
        "No additional filter beyond the stated bilinear density representation",
        "Distance-weighted nodal sensitivity filter with radius h=L/4",
        "Distance-weighted nodal sensitivity filter with radius 1.5h=3L/8"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Displacement finite-element interpolation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 4×4 grid and 25 bilinear density controls are specified, but the displacement approximation order is not. Saying FEM uses the same mesh does not specify its displacement shape functions.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilateral displacement elements on the 16 cells",
        "Nine-node biquadratic quadrilateral displacement elements on the same 16 cells, retaining the 25 bilinear density controls"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Stiffness integration within each element",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The stated volume quadrature does not specify stiffness quadrature. This matters because Eq. (6) applies a cubic SIMP law to a spatially varying bilinear density.",
      "readings": [
        "Evaluate Y(ρ) using 2×2 Gauss quadrature per cell",
        "Evaluate Y(ρ) using 3×3 Gauss quadrature per cell",
        "Evaluate Y(ρ) using higher-order quadrature converged for element stiffness"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
